sentences.zh: 竇參，字時中，工部尚書誕之玄孫。

translations.literal: Dou Can, styled Shizhong, was the great-great-grandson of Dan, Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Can (styled Shizhong) was the great-great-grandson of Dan, Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 父審言，聞喜尉，以參貴贈吏部尚書。

translations.literal: His father Shenyan was Warden of Wenxi; because of Can's eminence he was posthumously made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shenyan had been magistrate of Wenxi; when Can rose to prominence, Shenyan was posthumously appointed Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 參習法令，通政術，性矜嚴，強直而果斷。

translations.literal: Can studied statutes and understood statecraft; his nature was stern and proud, forceful, upright, and decisive.
translations.idiomatic: Can mastered the law codes and statecraft; he was stern and proud, forceful, upright, and decisive.

sentences.zh: 少以門廕，累官至萬年尉。

translations.literal: In youth, through hereditary privilege, he rose in succession to the post of Warden of Wannian.
translations.idiomatic: Through hereditary privilege in youth, he rose step by step to Warden of Wannian.

sentences.zh: 時同僚有直官曹者，將夕，聞親疾，請參代之。

translations.literal: At the time a colleague on duty in the office, as evening approached, heard that a parent was ill and asked Can to substitute for him.
translations.idiomatic: A colleague on duty in the office, hearing near evening that a parent was ill, asked Can to stand in for him.

sentences.zh: 會獄囚亡走，京兆尹按直簿，將奏，參遽請曰：「彼以不及狀謁，參實代之，宜當罪。」

translations.literal: It happened that a prisoner escaped from jail. The Metropolitan Governor examined the duty register and was about to memorialize. Can hastily pleaded, saying: "He failed to report in the proper form; Can actually substituted for him. The blame ought to fall on me.
translations.idiomatic: A prisoner escaped from jail. The Metropolitan Governor checked the duty register and was about to submit a report. Can at once pleaded, saying, "He failed to report in the proper form; I actually substituted for him. The blame ought to fall on me."

sentences.zh: 坐貶江夏尉，人多義之。

translations.literal: ". For this he was demoted to Warden of Jiangxia; many regarded his conduct as righteous.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to Warden of Jiangxia for the offense; many regarded his conduct as righteous.

sentences.zh: 累遷奉先尉。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Warden of Fengxian.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to Warden of Fengxian.

sentences.zh: 縣人曹芬，名隸北軍，芬素兇暴，因醉毆其女弟，其父救之不得，遂投井死。

translations.literal: A county man, Cao Fen, was registered by name in the Northern Army. Fen was habitually fierce and violent. Drunk, he beat his younger sister; their father tried to save her but could not, and threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: A county man named Cao Fen was enrolled in the Northern Army. Fen was habitually fierce and violent. Drunk, he beat his younger sister; their father tried to rescue her but failed and threw himself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 參捕理芬兄弟當死，眾官皆請俟免喪，參曰：「子因父生，父由子死，若以喪延罪，是殺父不坐也。」

translations.literal: Can arrested and tried the Fen brothers for a capital offense. All the officials asked that punishment wait until mourning was finished. Can said: "A son exists because of the father; a father dies because of the son. If mourning delays punishment, then killing a father goes unpunished."
translations.idiomatic: Can arrested and tried the Fen brothers for a capital offense. The other officials all asked that punishment wait until mourning was finished. Can said, "A son exists because of the father; a father dies because of the son. If mourning delays punishment, then killing a father goes unpunished."

sentences.zh: 皆正其罪而杖殺之，一縣畏伏。

translations.literal: He fixed their guilt according to law and had them beaten to death; the whole county feared and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He fixed their guilt according to law and had them beaten to death; the whole county feared and submitted.

sentences.zh: 轉大理司直。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Directing Censor of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Directing Censor of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 按獄江淮，次揚州，節度使陳少遊驕蹇，不郊迎，令軍吏傳問，參正辭讓之，少遊悔懼，促詣參，參不俟濟江。

translations.literal: Examining cases in the Jiang-Huai region, he stopped at Yangzhou. The military governor Chen Shaoyou was arrogant and overbearing and did not go out to the suburbs to welcome him, but had army clerks relay inquiries. Can spoke forthrightly and reproved him. Shaoyou repented and feared, and urged that he come to Can; Can did not wait to cross the river.
translations.idiomatic: While examining cases in the Jiang-Huai region he stopped at Yangzhou. Military Governor Chen Shaoyou was arrogant and overbearing and did not go out to the suburbs to welcome him, but had army clerks relay inquiries. Can spoke forthrightly and reproved him. Shaoyou repented and feared, and urged Can to come; Can did not wait to cross the river.

sentences.zh: 還奏合旨。

translations.literal: On his return his memorial accorded with the emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: On his return his memorial accorded with the emperor's intent.

sentences.zh: 時婺州刺史鄧珽坐贓八千貫，珽與執政有舊，以會赦，欲免贓。

translations.literal: At the time the prefect of Wu Prefecture, Deng Ting, was convicted of embezzling eight thousand strings of cash. Ting had old ties with those in power, and because an amnesty coincided with the case, they wished to remit the embezzled goods.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wu Prefecture Governor Deng Ting was convicted of embezzling eight thousand strings of cash. Ting had old ties with those in power, and because an amnesty coincided with the case, they wished to remit the embezzled goods.

sentences.zh: 詔百僚於尚書省雜議，多希執政意，參獨堅執正之於法，竟征贓。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the hundred officials to deliberate jointly in the Ministry of Personnel. Most hoped to please those in power; Can alone firmly insisted on applying the law and in the end the embezzled goods were levied.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the hundred officials to deliberate jointly in the Ministry of Personnel. Most hoped to please those in power; Can alone firmly insisted on applying the law, and in the end the embezzled goods were levied.

sentences.zh: 明年，除監察御史，奉使按湖南判官馬彜獄。

translations.literal: The next year he was made Supervising Censor and sent on mission to investigate the case of the Hunan judge Ma Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was made Supervising Censor and sent on mission to investigate the case of Hunan judge Ma Yi.

sentences.zh: 時彜舉屬令贓罪至千貫，為得罪者之子因權幸誣奏彜，參竟白彜無罪。

translations.literal: At the time Yi had reported a subordinate magistrate for embezzling as much as a thousand strings of cash. The son of the convicted man, through a favorite of power, falsely memorialized against Yi. Can in the end cleared Yi of guilt.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yi had reported a subordinate magistrate for embezzling as much as a thousand strings of cash. The son of the convicted man, through a favorite of power, falsely memorialized against Yi. Can in the end cleared Yi of guilt.

sentences.zh: 彜實能吏，後累佐曹王臯，以正直強幹聞。

translations.literal: Yi was in truth a capable official; later he served repeatedly under Prince Cao Li Gao and was known for uprightness and forceful competence.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was in truth a capable official; later he served repeatedly under Prince Cao Li Gao and was known for uprightness and forceful competence.

sentences.zh: 參轉殿中侍御史，改金部員外郎、刑部郎中、侍御史、知雜事。

translations.literal: Can was transferred to Attending Censor within the Palace, then changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue, Director in the Ministry of Justice, Attending Censor, and Supervisor of Miscellaneous Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Can was transferred to Attending Censor within the Palace, then changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue, Director in the Ministry of Justice, Attending Censor, and Supervisor of Miscellaneous Affairs.

sentences.zh: 無幾，遷御史中丞，不避權貴，理獄以嚴稱。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to Censor-in-Chief. He did not avoid the powerful and noble and was known for strict handling of cases.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to Censor-in-Chief. He did not avoid the powerful and noble and was known for strict handling of cases.

sentences.zh: 數蒙召見，論天下事，又與執政多異同，上深器之，或參決大政。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly summoned and received in audience to discuss affairs of the realm. He also differed often from those in power, and the emperor greatly valued him and sometimes had him participate in deciding great affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly summoned and received in audience to discuss affairs of the realm. He also differed often from those in power, and the emperor greatly valued him and sometimes had him participate in deciding great affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 時宰頗忌之，多所排抑，亦無以傷參。

translations.literal: The chief ministers were quite jealous of him and repeatedly blocked and suppressed him, yet could not harm Can.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers were quite jealous of him and repeatedly blocked and suppressed him, yet could not harm Can.

sentences.zh: 然多率情壞法。

translations.literal: Yet he often followed personal inclination and damaged the law.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he often followed personal inclination and damaged the law.

sentences.zh: 初定百官俸料，以嘗為司直，黨其官，故給俸多於本寺丞；

translations.literal: When the salaries of the hundred officials were first fixed, because he had once been a Directing Censor he favored that office, so its salary was set higher than that of the regular directors of the court;
translations.idiomatic: When the salaries of the hundred officials were first fixed, because he had once been a Directing Censor he favored that office, so its salary was set higher than that of the regular directors of the court;

sentences.zh: 又定百官班秩，初令太常少卿在左右庶子之上；

translations.literal: when the ranks and order of the hundred officials were fixed, he first placed the Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices above the Left and Right Mentors of the Heir Apparent;
translations.idiomatic: when the ranks and order of the hundred officials were fixed, he first placed the Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices above the Left and Right Mentors of the Heir Apparent;

sentences.zh: 又惡詹事李昇，遂移詹事班退居諸府尹之下，甚為有識所嗤。

translations.literal: and because he hated the Mentor of the Heir Apparent Li Sheng, he moved the Mentor's rank down below all the prefects of the capital districts, which knowledgeable men greatly ridiculed.
translations.idiomatic: and because he hated Mentor of the Heir Apparent Li Sheng, he moved the Mentor's rank down below all the prefects of the capital districts, which knowledgeable men greatly ridiculed.

sentences.zh: 尋兼戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally made Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally made Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 時京師人家豕生兩首四足，有司欲奏；

translations.literal: At the time in the capital a household's pig bore two heads and four feet; the relevant offices wished to memorialize it;
translations.idiomatic: At the time in the capital a household's pig bore two heads and four feet; the relevant offices wished to memorialize it;

sentences.zh: 參曰：「此為豕禍，安可上聞！」

translations.literal: Can said: "This is a pig calamity—how can it be reported above!"
translations.idiomatic: Can said, "This is a pig calamity—how can it be reported above!"

sentences.zh: 命棄之。

translations.literal: He ordered it discarded.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered it discarded.

sentences.zh: 是時，郊牛生犢有六足者，太仆卿周皓白宰相請奏，李泌亦戲答以遣之。

translations.literal: At that time a sacrificial ox bore a calf with six feet. The Minister of Imperial Stud Zhou Hao told the chief ministers and asked to memorialize it; Li Bi also answered in jest and sent them away.
translations.idiomatic: At that time a sacrificial ox bore a calf with six feet. Minister of Imperial Stud Zhou Hao told the chief ministers and asked to memorialize it; Li Bi also answered in jest and sent them away.

sentences.zh: 故淮南節度使陳少遊子正儀請襲封，參大署尚書省門曰：「陳少遊位兼將相之崇，節變艱危之際，君上含垢，未能發明，愚子何心，輒求傳襲。」

translations.literal: The former military governor of Huainan, Chen Shaoyou's son Zhengyi, requested inherited enfeoffment. Can wrote in large characters on the gate of the Ministry of Personnel: "Chen Shaoyou's rank combined the eminence of general and minister. At a juncture when the realm changed amid peril, the sovereign bore disgrace and could not yet make the matter clear. What heart has this foolish son to rashly seek transmission and inheritance?"
translations.idiomatic: Former Huainan Military Governor Chen Shaoyou's son Zhengyi requested inherited enfeoffment. Can wrote in large characters on the gate of the Ministry of Personnel: "Chen Shaoyou's rank combined the eminence of general and minister. At a juncture when the realm changed amid peril, the sovereign bore disgrace and could not yet make the matter clear. What heart has this foolish son to rashly seek transmission and inheritance?"

sentences.zh: 正儀懼，不敢求封而去。

translations.literal: Zhengyi feared this and did not dare seek enfeoffment, but left.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengyi feared this and did not dare seek enfeoffment, but left.

sentences.zh: 時神策將軍孟華有戰功，為大將軍所誣奏，稱華謀反；

translations.literal: At the time the Shence general Meng Hua had merit in battle but was falsely memorialized by a great general, who said Hua plotted rebellion;
translations.idiomatic: At the time Shence General Meng Hua had merit in battle but was falsely memorialized by a great general, who said Hua plotted rebellion;

sentences.zh: 有右龍武將軍李建玉，前陷吐蕃，久之自拔，為部曲誣告潛通吐蕃，皆當死，無以自白，參悉理出之，由是人皆屬望。

translations.literal: there was also Right Dragon Guard General Li Jian-yu, who had earlier been trapped by the Tibetans and after long time extricated himself, but was falsely accused by his troops of secretly communicating with the Tibetans. All were liable to death and had no way to clear themselves. Can fully tried the cases and cleared them all; from this everyone looked to him with hope.
translations.idiomatic: there was also Right Dragon Guard General Li Jian-yu, who had earlier been trapped by the Tibetans and after a long time extricated himself, but was falsely accused by his troops of secretly communicating with the Tibetans. All were liable to death and had no way to clear themselves. Can fully tried the cases and cleared them all; from this everyone looked to him with hope.

sentences.zh: 明年，拜中書侍郎、同平章事，領度支、鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-equal Commissioner of the Chancellery, and concurrently head of the Bureau of Revenue and Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-equal Commissioner of the Chancellery, and concurrently head of the Bureau of Revenue and Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 每宰相間日於延英召對，諸相皆出，參必居後久之，以度支為辭，實專大政。

translations.literal: Whenever the chief ministers were summoned on alternate days for audience in Yanying Hall, all the chancellors would leave; Can always remained behind for a long time. He used the Bureau of Revenue as his excuse, but in fact monopolized great affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the chief ministers were summoned on alternate days for audience in Yanying Hall, all the chancellors would leave; Can always remained behind for a long time. He used the Bureau of Revenue as his excuse, but in fact monopolized great affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 參無學術，但多引用親黨，使居要職，以為耳目，四方籓帥，皆畏懼之。

translations.literal: Can had no learning, but repeatedly appointed kin and partisans to important posts as his eyes and ears; military governors in all directions feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Can had no learning, but repeatedly appointed kin and partisans to important posts as his eyes and ears; military governors in all directions feared him.

sentences.zh: 李納既憚參，饋遺畢至，外示敬參，實陰間之。

translations.literal: Li Na already feared Can, and gifts arrived in full; outwardly he showed respect for Can, but in secret he undermined him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Na already feared Can, and gifts arrived in full; outwardly he showed respect for Can, but in secret he undermined him.

sentences.zh: 上所親信，多非毀參。

translations.literal: Those the emperor personally trusted mostly slandered Can.
translations.idiomatic: Those the emperor personally trusted mostly slandered Can.

sentences.zh: 竇申又與吳通玄通犯事覺，參任情好惡，恃權貪利，不知紀極，終以此敗。

translations.literal: Dou Shen also communicated with Wu Tongxuan, and when the affair was discovered, Can followed personal likes and dislikes, relied on power and coveted profit, and knew no limit—he was ruined in the end because of this.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Shen also communicated with Wu Tongxuan, and when the affair was discovered, Can followed personal likes and dislikes, relied on power and coveted profit, and knew no limit—he was ruined in the end because of this.

sentences.zh: 貶參郴州別駕，貞元八年四月也。

translations.literal: Can was demoted to Vice-Prefect of Chen Prefecture—in the fourth month of Zhenyuan 8.
translations.idiomatic: Can was demoted to Vice-Prefect of Chen Prefecture—in the fourth month of Zhenyuan 8.

sentences.zh: 參至郴州，汴州節度使劉士寧遺參絹五千匹。

translations.literal: When Can reached Chen Prefecture, Bianzhou Military Governor Liu Shining sent him five thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: When Can reached Chen Prefecture, Bianzhou Military Governor Liu Shining sent him five thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 湖南觀察使李巽與參有隙，遂具以聞；

translations.literal: Hunan Observation Commissioner Li Xun had a rift with Can and reported the matter in full;
translations.idiomatic: Hunan Observation Commissioner Li Xun had a rift with Can and reported the matter in full;

sentences.zh: 又中使逢士寧使於路，亦奏其事。

translations.literal: a palace emissary also encountered Shining's envoy on the road and likewise memorialized the affair.
translations.idiomatic: a palace emissary also encountered Shining's envoy on the road and likewise memorialized the affair.

sentences.zh: 德宗大怒，欲殺參。

translations.literal: Dezong was greatly enraged and wished to kill Can.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong was greatly enraged and wished to kill Can.

sentences.zh: 宰相陛贄曰：「竇參與臣無分，因事報怨，人之常情。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Lu Zhi said: "Dou Can and I have no private tie. Taking revenge over an affair is human feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Lu Zhi said, "Dou Can and I have no private tie. Taking revenge over an affair is human feeling.

sentences.zh: 然臣參宰衡，合存公體，以參罪犯，置之於死，恐用刑太過。」

translations.literal: Yet I participate in the chief ministership and ought to preserve public form. To put Can to death for his offense may be excessive punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Yet I participate in the chief ministership and ought to preserve public form. To put Can to death for his offense may be excessive punishment."

sentences.zh: 於是且止。

translations.literal: Thereupon the matter was halted for the time being.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the matter was halted for the time being.

sentences.zh: 尋又遣中使謂贄等曰：「卿等所奏，於大體雖好，然此人交結中外，其意難測，朕尋情狀，其事灼然。

translations.literal: Soon afterward an emissary was again sent to tell Zhi and the others: "What you memorialized is good in broad outline, yet this man has connections within and without; his intent is hard to fathom. I have traced the circumstances, and the matter is clearly established.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward an emissary was again sent to tell Zhi and the others, "What you memorialized is good in broad outline, yet this man has connections within and without; his intent is hard to fathom. I have traced the circumstances, and the matter is clearly established.

sentences.zh: 又竇參在彼，與諸戎帥交通，社稷事重，卿等速進文書處分。」

translations.literal: Moreover Dou Can there is in contact with the various frontier commanders. The affair of the altars of state is weighty; you must quickly advance documents for disposition."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Dou Can there is in contact with the various frontier commanders. The affair of the altars of state is weighty; you must quickly advance documents for disposition."

sentences.zh: 贄奏曰：「臣面承德音，幸奉密旨，皆以社稷為言，又知根尋已審，敢不上同憂憤，內絕狐疑，豈願遲回，更貽念慮？

translations.literal: Zhi memorialized, saying: "Your servant has received the imperial voice face to face and, fortunate to receive the secret edict, all spoke of the altars of state. Knowing too that the investigation has already been thorough, how dare I not share the same grief and indignation above and cut off doubt within? Would I wish to delay and give further cause for concern?
translations.idiomatic: Zhi memorialized, saying, "Your servant has received the imperial voice face to face and, fortunate to receive the secret edict, all spoke of the altars of state. Knowing too that the investigation has already been thorough, how dare I not share the same grief and indignation above and cut off doubt within? Would I wish to delay and give further cause for concern?

sentences.zh: 但以參常經重任，斯謂大臣，進退之間，猶宜有禮，誅戮之際，不可無名。

translations.literal: But because Can once bore heavy responsibility, this is what is called a great minister. Between advancement and withdrawal there should still be propriety; at the moment of execution there must be no lack of grounds.
translations.idiomatic: But because Can once bore heavy responsibility, this is what is called a great minister. Between advancement and withdrawal there should still be propriety; at the moment of execution there must be no lack of grounds.

sentences.zh: 劉晏久掌貨財，當時亦招怨讟，及加罪責，事不分明，叛者既得以為辭，眾人亦為之懷湣。

translations.literal: Liu Yan long managed goods and wealth and at the time also drew resentment and slander. When guilt was added and punishment imposed, the matter was not clear. Rebels could then use it as a pretext, and the multitude also felt pity for him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan long managed goods and wealth and at the time also drew resentment and slander. When guilt was added and punishment imposed, the matter was not clear. Rebels could then use it as a pretext, and the multitude also felt pity for him.

sentences.zh: 用刑曖昧，損累不輕，事例未遙，所宜重慎。

translations.literal: When punishment is obscure, the harm is not light; the precedent is not distant, and one ought to be heavily cautious.
translations.idiomatic: When punishment is obscure, the harm is not light; the precedent is not distant, and one ought to be heavily cautious.

sentences.zh: 竇參頃司鈞軸，頗怙恩私，貪受貨財，引縱親黨，此則朝廷同議，天下共傳。

translations.literal: Dou Can recently held the balance of power and greatly relied on private favor, accepted bribes, and indulged kin and partisans—this the court discussed together and the realm commonly reported.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Can recently held the balance of power and greatly relied on private favor, accepted bribes, and indulged kin and partisans—this the court discussed together and the realm commonly reported.

sentences.zh: 至於潛懷異圖，將起大惡，跡既未露，人皆莫知。

translations.literal: As for secretly harboring a different design and about to raise great evil—the traces have not yet been exposed, and no one knows.
translations.idiomatic: As for secretly harboring a different design and about to raise great evil—the traces have not yet been exposed, and no one knows.

sentences.zh: 臣等新奉天顏，議加刑辟，但聞兇險之意，尚昧結構之由。

translations.literal: We have newly received the heavenly countenance and discuss adding capital punishment, yet we have heard only of treacherous intent and still do not know the grounds of the plot.
translations.idiomatic: We have newly received the heavenly countenance and discuss adding capital punishment, yet we have heard only of treacherous intent and still do not know the grounds of the plot.

sentences.zh: 況在眾流，何由備悉，忽行峻罰，必謂冤誣，群情震驚，事亦非細。

translations.literal: Moreover, among the multitude of officials, how can all be fully informed? If severe punishment is suddenly applied, it will surely be taken as false accusation; public sentiment will be shaken, and the affair is no small matter.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, among the multitude of officials, how can all be fully informed? If severe punishment is suddenly applied, it will surely be taken as false accusation; public sentiment will be shaken, and the affair is no small matter.

sentences.zh: 若不付外推鞫，則恐難定罪名，乞留睿聰，更少詳度。

translations.literal: If it is not handed over for external investigation and interrogation, I fear it will be hard to fix the charge. I beg that sagely attention be retained and further deliberation be given.
translations.idiomatic: If it is not handed over for external investigation and interrogation, I fear it will be hard to fix the charge. I beg that sagely attention be retained and further deliberation be given.

sentences.zh: 竇參於臣，素亦無分，陛下固已明知，有何顧懷，輒欲營救？

translations.literal: Dou Can and I have never had a private tie; Your Majesty already knows this clearly. What concern would make me rashly wish to rescue him?
translations.idiomatic: Dou Can and I have never had a private tie; Your Majesty already knows this clearly. What concern would make me rashly wish to rescue him?

sentences.zh: 良以事關國體，義絕私嫌，所冀典刑不濫於清時，君道免虧於聖德。」

translations.literal: Truly because the affair concerns the body of the state, righteousness cuts off private resentment, I hope that punishments may not be excessive in a time of clarity, and the way of the ruler may be kept from loss in sagely virtue."
translations.idiomatic: Truly because the affair concerns the body of the state, righteousness cuts off private resentment, I hope that punishments may not be excessive in a time of clarity, and the way of the ruler may be kept from loss in sagely virtue."

sentences.zh: 乃再貶為驩州司馬。

translations.literal: He was then demoted again to Administrator of Huan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was then demoted again to Administrator of Huan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 男景伯，配泉州；

translations.literal: His son Jingbo was banished to Quan Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: His son Jingbo was banished to Quan Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 女尼真如，隸郴州；

translations.literal: his daughter the nun Zhenru was assigned to Chen Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: his daughter the nun Zhenru was assigned to Chen Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 其財物婢妾，傳送京師。

translations.literal: his goods, property, and concubines were sent on to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: his goods, property, and concubines were sent on to the capital.

sentences.zh: 參時為左右中官深怒，謗沮不已，未至驩州，賜死於邕州武經鎮，時年六十。

translations.literal: Can at the time was deeply hated by the eunuchs of left and right, who slandered and obstructed him without cease. Before he reached Huan Prefecture he was granted death at Wujing garrison in Yong Prefecture, aged sixty.
translations.idiomatic: Can at the time was deeply hated by the eunuchs of left and right, who slandered and obstructed him without cease. Before he reached Huan Prefecture he was granted death at Wujing garrison in Yong Prefecture, aged sixty.

sentences.zh: 竇申者，參之族子。

translations.literal: Dou Shen was a clansman of Can.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Shen was a clansman of Can.

sentences.zh: 累遷至京兆少尹，轉給事中。

translations.literal: He rose in succession to Junior Vice-Governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture and was transferred to Drafting Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to Junior Vice-Governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture and was transferred to Drafting Attendant.

sentences.zh: 參特愛之，每議除授，多訪於申，申或泄之，以招權受賂。

translations.literal: Can especially favored him. Whenever appointments and dismissals were discussed, Can often consulted Shen; Shen sometimes leaked them to gain power and accept bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Can especially favored him. Whenever appointments and dismissals were discussed, Can often consulted Shen; Shen sometimes leaked them to gain power and accept bribes.

sentences.zh: 申所至，人目之為喜鵲。

translations.literal: Wherever Shen went, people regarded him as a magpie of good omen.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever Shen went, people regarded him as a magpie of good omen.

sentences.zh: 德宗頗聞其事，數誡參曰：「卿他日必為申所累，不如出之以掩物議。」

translations.literal: Dezong heard much of this affair and repeatedly admonished Can, saying: "You will one day surely be burdened by Shen. Better to send him out to cover public criticism."
translations.idiomatic: Dezong heard much of this affair and repeatedly admonished Can, saying, "You will one day surely be burdened by Shen. Better to send him out to cover public criticism."

sentences.zh: 參曰：「臣無強子侄，申雖疏屬，臣素親之，不忍遠出，請保無他犯。」

translations.literal: Can said: "Your servant has no strong sons or nephews. Though Shen is a distant relative, I have always been close to him and cannot bear to send him far away. I ask to guarantee he will commit no other offense."
translations.idiomatic: Can said, "Your servant has no strong sons or nephews. Though Shen is a distant relative, I have always been close to him and cannot bear to send him far away. I ask to guarantee he will commit no other offense."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿雖自保，如眾人何？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Though you protect yourself, what of the multitude?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Though you protect yourself, what of the multitude?"

sentences.zh: 參固如前對。

translations.literal: Can persisted in his former reply.
translations.idiomatic: Can persisted in his former reply.

sentences.zh: 申亦不悛。

translations.literal: Shen also did not repent.
translations.idiomatic: Shen also did not repent.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎陸贄與參有隙。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Ministry of War Lu Zhi had a rift with Can.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Ministry of War Lu Zhi had a rift with Can.

sentences.zh: 吳通微弟兄與贄同在翰林，俱承德宗顧遇，亦爭寵不協。

translations.literal: The brothers Wu Tongwei and Wu Tongxuan were together with Zhi in the Hanlin Academy, all receiving Dezong's favor, and they too competed for favor and were not in accord.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers Wu Tongwei and Wu Tongxuan were together with Zhi in the Hanlin Academy, all receiving Dezong's favor, and they too competed for favor and were not in accord.

sentences.zh: 金吾大將軍、嗣虢王則之與申及通微、通玄善，遂相與傾。

translations.literal: General of the Golden Guard, Heir of the Prince of Guo Ze Zhi, was on good terms with Shen and Tongwei and Tongxuan, and so they joined in overthrowing Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Golden Guard, Heir of the Prince of Guo Ze Zhi, was on good terms with Shen and Tongwei and Tongxuan, and so they joined in overthrowing Zhi.

sentences.zh: 贄考貢舉，言贄考貢不實。

translations.literal: On Zhi's conduct of the examination selection, they said Zhi's examination selection was not genuine.
translations.idiomatic: On Zhi's conduct of the examination selection, they said Zhi's examination selection was not genuine.

sentences.zh: 吳通玄取宗室女為外婦，德宗知其毀贄，且令察視，具得其奸狀，乃貶則之為昭州司馬，吳通玄為泉州司馬，竇申為道州司馬。

translations.literal: Wu Tongxuan took a clanswoman as an outside wife. Dezong knew he slandered Zhi and also ordered investigation; the full extent of his wicked conduct was obtained. Thereupon Ze Zhi was demoted to Administrator of Zhao Prefecture, Wu Tongxuan to Administrator of Quan Prefecture, and Dou Shen to Administrator of Dao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tongxuan took a clanswoman as an outside wife. Dezong knew he slandered Zhi and also ordered investigation; the full extent of his wicked conduct was obtained. Thereupon Ze Zhi was demoted to Administrator of Zhao Prefecture, Wu Tongxuan to Administrator of Quan Prefecture, and Dou Shen to Administrator of Dao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 不旬日貶參郴州別駕，即日以陸贄為宰相。

translations.literal: Within ten days Can was demoted to Vice-Prefect of Chen Prefecture, and on the same day Lu Zhi was made chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten days Can was demoted to Vice-Prefect of Chen Prefecture, and on the same day Lu Zhi was made chief minister.

sentences.zh: 明年，竇參再貶驩州。

translations.literal: The next year Dou Can was demoted again to Huan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Dou Can was demoted again to Huan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 德宗謂陸贄曰：「竇申、竇榮、李則之首末同惡，無所不至，又並細微，不比竇參，便宜商量處置，所有親密，並發遣於遠惡處。」

translations.literal: Dezong said to Lu Zhi: "Dou Shen, Dou Rong, and Li Ze Zhi from first to last share the same evil and stop at nothing. They are also all insignificant men, not comparable to Dou Can. You should conveniently discuss disposition. All who were intimate with them are to be sent off to distant and vile places."
translations.idiomatic: Dezong said to Lu Zhi, "Dou Shen, Dou Rong, and Li Ze Zhi from first to last share the same evil and stop at nothing. They are also all insignificant men, not comparable to Dou Can. You should conveniently discuss disposition. All who were intimate with them are to be sent off to distant and vile places."

sentences.zh: 贄奏曰：

translations.literal: Zhi memorialized, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Zhi memorialized, saying:

sentences.zh: 竇參罪犯，誠合誅夷，聖德含弘，務全事體，特寬嚴憲，俯貸余生。

translations.literal: Dou Can's offenses truly merit execution. Sagely virtue is broad and tolerant, striving to preserve the whole affair; specially lenient in strict law, bowing to spare the remainder of life.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Can's offenses truly merit execution. Sagely virtue is broad and tolerant, striving to preserve the whole affair; specially lenient in strict law, bowing to spare the remainder of life.

sentences.zh: 始終之恩，實足感於庶品；

translations.literal: Favor from beginning to end truly suffices to move the multitude;
translations.idiomatic: Favor from beginning to end truly suffices to move the multitude;

sentences.zh: 仁煦之惠，不獨幸於斯人。

translations.literal: the kindness of gentle warmth is not a private fortune for this man alone.
translations.idiomatic: the kindness of gentle warmth is not a private fortune for this man alone.

sentences.zh: 所議貶官，謹具別狀。

translations.literal: The demoted offices discussed are respectfully set forth in a separate memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The demoted offices discussed are respectfully set forth in a separate memorial.

sentences.zh: 其竇申、竇榮、李則之等，即皆同惡，固亦難容；

translations.literal: As for Dou Shen, Dou Rong, Li Ze Zhi, and the like, they all share the same evil and are indeed hard to tolerate;
translations.idiomatic: As for Dou Shen, Dou Rong, Li Ze Zhi, and the like, they all share the same evil and are indeed hard to tolerate;

sentences.zh: 然以得罪相因，法有首從，首當居重，從合從輕。

translations.literal: yet because guilt follows in connection, the law has principal and follower: the principal ought to bear the heavy penalty, the follower ought to be treated lightly.
translations.idiomatic: yet because guilt follows in connection, the law has principal and follower: the principal ought to bear the heavy penalty, the follower ought to be treated lightly.

sentences.zh: 參既蒙恩矜全，申等亦宜減降。

translations.literal: Since Can has received gracious sparing, Shen and the others should also be reduced and lowered.
translations.idiomatic: Since Can has received gracious sparing, Shen and the others should also be reduced and lowered.

sentences.zh: 又於黨與之內，亦有淑慝之殊，稍示區分，足彰沮勸。

translations.literal: Moreover within the faction there are also differences between the good and the wicked; to show a little distinction suffices to display discouragement and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover within the faction there are also differences between the good and the wicked; to show a little distinction suffices to display discouragement and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 竇榮與參雖非近屬，亦甚相親，然於款密之中，都無邪僻之事。

translations.literal: Dou Rong and Can, though not close kin, were also very intimate; yet in close confidence there were no depraved affairs at all.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Rong and Can, though not close kin, were also very intimate; yet in close confidence there were no depraved affairs at all.

sentences.zh: 仍聞激憤，屢有直言，因此漸構猜嫌，晚年頗見疏忌。

translations.literal: It was also heard that in indignation he repeatedly spoke frankly; because of this suspicion gradually formed, and in his later years he was much seen as distant and suspected.
translations.idiomatic: It was also heard that in indignation he repeatedly spoke frankly; because of this suspicion gradually formed, and in his later years he was much seen as distant and suspected.

sentences.zh: 若論今者陰事，則尚未究端由，如據比來所行，應不至兇險，恐須差異，以表詳明。

translations.literal: If one discusses present secret affairs, the origin has not yet been fully investigated; if one goes by recent conduct, it should not reach treacherous danger. I fear a difference in treatment is needed to show clarity.
translations.idiomatic: If one discusses present secret affairs, the origin has not yet been fully investigated; if one goes by recent conduct, it should not reach treacherous danger. I fear a difference in treatment is needed to show clarity.

sentences.zh: 臣等商量，竇榮更貶遠官，竇申、則之並除名配流，庶允從輕之典，以洽好生之恩。

translations.literal: We have deliberated: Dou Rong should be demoted further to a distant office; Dou Shen and Ze Zhi should both be stripped of name and banished—then the lighter standard may be satisfied and the grace of cherishing life fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: We have deliberated: Dou Rong should be demoted further to a distant office; Dou Shen and Ze Zhi should both be stripped of name and banished—then the lighter standard may be satisfied and the grace of cherishing life fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 夫趨勢附權，時俗常態，茍無高節出眾，何能特立不群？

translations.literal: To rush toward power and attach to influence is the common custom of the age. Without lofty integrity standing out, how can one stand alone apart from the crowd?
translations.idiomatic: To rush toward power and attach to influence is the common custom of the age. Without lofty integrity standing out, how can one stand alone apart from the crowd?

sentences.zh: 竇參久塵鈞衡，特承寵渥，君之所任，孰敢不從？

translations.literal: Dou Can long bore the balance of power and specially received lavish favor. Whom the ruler appoints—who dares not follow?
translations.idiomatic: Dou Can long bore the balance of power and specially received lavish favor. Whom the ruler appoints—who dares not follow?

sentences.zh: 或遊於門庭，或序以中表，或偏被接引，或驟與薦延，如此之徒，十常八九。

translations.literal: Some visited his gate and court; some were connected as cousins by marriage; some were specially received and guided; some were suddenly recommended and promoted—men of this sort were eight or nine in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Some visited his gate and court; some were connected as cousins by marriage; some were specially received and guided; some were suddenly recommended and promoted—men of this sort were eight or nine in ten.

sentences.zh: 若聽流議，皆謂黨私，自非甚與交親，安可悉從貶累？

translations.literal: If one listens to loose talk, all will be called factional favoritism. Unless one were very close in friendship, how could all be demoted together?
translations.idiomatic: If one listens to loose talk, all will be called factional favoritism. Unless one were very close in friendship, how could all be demoted together?

sentences.zh: 況竇參罷黜，殆欲周星，應是私黨近親，當時並已連坐，人心久定，不可復搖。

translations.literal: Moreover Dou Can was dismissed nearly a full year ago; private partisans and close kin should already have been implicated together at the time. Public sentiment has long settled and must not be shaken again.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Dou Can was dismissed nearly a full year ago; private partisans and close kin should already have been implicated together at the time. Public sentiment has long settled and must not be shaken again.

sentences.zh: 臣等商量，除與竇參陰謀邪事處，一切不問。

translations.literal: We have deliberated: except in cases of secret plotting and wicked affairs with Dou Can, all are not to be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: We have deliberated: except in cases of secret plotting and wicked affairs with Dou Can, all are not to be questioned.

sentences.zh: 詔從之，由是申等得配流嶺南。

translations.literal: An edict followed this, and Shen and the others were banished to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed this, and Shen and the others were banished to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 既賜參死，乃杖殺申，諸竇皆貶，榮得免死。

translations.literal: After Can was granted death, Shen was beaten to death; all the Dou clan were demoted, and Rong escaped death.
translations.idiomatic: After Can was granted death, Shen was beaten to death; all the Dou clan were demoted, and Rong escaped death.

sentences.zh: 齊映，瀛州高陽人。

translations.literal: Qi Ying was a man of Gaoyang in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ying was from Gaoyang in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父圮，試太常少卿，兼檢校工部郎中。

translations.literal: His father Qi was Acting Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and concurrently Investigating Commissioner in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: His father Qi was Acting Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and concurrently Investigating Commissioner in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 映登進士第，應博學宏辭，授河南府參軍。

translations.literal: Ying passed the jinshi examination and responded to the Examination in Eminent Learning and Comprehensive Phrasing; he was appointed Army Aide of Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ying passed the jinshi examination and responded to the Examination in Eminent Learning and Comprehensive Phrasing; he was appointed Army Aide of Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 滑亳節度使令狐彰辟為掌書記，累授監察御史。

translations.literal: Huai-Bian Military Governor Linghu Zhang summoned him as Chief Clerk and repeatedly appointed him Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-Bian Military Governor Linghu Zhang summoned him as Chief Clerk and repeatedly appointed him Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 彰疾甚，映草遺表，因與謀後事，映說彰令上表請代，令子建歸京師，彰皆從之，因妻以女。

translations.literal: When Zhang was gravely ill, Ying drafted the final memorial and together with him planned subsequent affairs. Ying persuaded Zhang to submit a memorial requesting replacement and to send his son Jian back to the capital; Zhang followed all of this and gave Ying his daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang was gravely ill, Ying drafted the final memorial and together with him planned subsequent affairs. Ying persuaded Zhang to submit a memorial requesting replacement and to send his son Jian back to the capital; Zhang followed all of this and gave Ying his daughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 彰卒後兵亂，映脫身歸東都，河陽三城使馬燧辟為判官，奏殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: After Zhang died there was military disorder; Ying escaped and returned to the Eastern Capital. He-Yang Three Cities Commissioner Ma Sui summoned him as judge and memorialized him as Attending Censor within the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang died there was military disorder; Ying escaped and returned to the Eastern Capital. He-Yang Three Cities Commissioner Ma Sui summoned him as judge and memorialized him as Attending Censor within the Palace.

sentences.zh: 建中初，盧杞為宰相，薦之，遷刑部員外郎，會張鎰出鎮鳳翔，奏為判官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jianzhong era Lu Qi was chief minister and recommended him; he was promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice. When Zhang Yi went out to garrison Fengxiang, he memorialized Ying as judge.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jianzhong era Lu Qi was chief minister and recommended him; he was promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice. When Zhang Yi went out to garrison Fengxiang, he memorialized Ying as judge.

sentences.zh: 映口辯，頗更軍事，數以論奏合旨，尋轉行軍司馬、兼御史中丞。

translations.literal: Ying was eloquent in speech and had considerable experience in military affairs. Several times his discourses and memorials accorded with the emperor's intent, and soon he was transferred to Army Marshal and concurrently Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was eloquent in speech and had considerable experience in military affairs. Several times his discourses and memorials accorded with the emperor's intent, and soon he was transferred to Army Marshal and concurrently Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 德宗在奉天，鳳翔逼於賊泚。

translations.literal: Dezong was at Fengtian; Fengxiang was pressed by the rebel Zhu Ci.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong was at Fengtian; Fengxiang was pressed by the rebel Zhu Ci.

sentences.zh: 鎰懦緩不曉兵家事，部將有李楚琳者，慓悍兇暴，軍中畏之，乘間將謀亂。

translations.literal: Yi was timid and slow and did not understand military affairs. Among his subordinate generals was Li Chu Lin, fierce, violent, and feared in the army; seizing an opportunity he was about to plot disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was timid and slow and did not understand military affairs. Among his subordinate generals was Li Chu Lin, fierce, violent, and feared in the army; seizing an opportunity he was about to plot disorder.

sentences.zh: 先數日，映與同列齊抗覺其謀，乃言於鎰，請早圖之。

translations.literal: Several days earlier Ying and his colleague Qi Kang perceived the plot and spoke to Yi, asking that he be dealt with early.
translations.idiomatic: Several days earlier Ying and his colleague Qi Kang perceived the plot and spoke to Yi, asking that he be dealt with early.

sentences.zh: 鎰不從映言，乃示其寬大，召楚琳語之曰：「欲令公使於外。」

translations.literal: Yi did not follow Ying's words but showed his magnanimity, summoned Chu Lin, and spoke to him, saying: "I wish to have you serve on the outside."
translations.idiomatic: Yi did not follow Ying's words but showed his magnanimity, summoned Chu Lin, and spoke to him, saying, "I wish to have you serve on the outside."

sentences.zh: 楚琳恐，是夜作亂，乃殺鎰以應泚；

translations.literal: Chu Lin feared this; that night he raised disorder, killed Yi to respond to Ci;
translations.idiomatic: Chu Lin feared this; that night he raised disorder, killed Yi to respond to Ci;

sentences.zh: 軍中多為映指道，故得免。

translations.literal: many in the army were directed by Ying and so escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: many in the army were directed by Ying and so escaped harm.

sentences.zh: 因赴奉天行在，除御史中丞。

translations.literal: Thereupon he went to the mobile court at Fengtian and was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he went to the mobile court at Fengtian and was made Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 興元初，從幸梁州，每過險，映常執轡。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xingyuan he followed the emperor to Liang Prefecture; whenever they passed dangerous places Ying always held the reins.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xingyuan he followed the emperor to Liang Prefecture; whenever they passed dangerous places Ying always held the reins.

sentences.zh: 會禦馬遽駭，奔跳頗甚，帝懼傷映，令舍轡，映堅執久之，乃止。

translations.literal: Once the imperial horse suddenly shied and ran and leaped greatly. The emperor feared Ying would be injured and ordered him to release the reins; Ying firmly held them for a long time before stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Once the imperial horse suddenly shied and ran and leaped greatly. The emperor feared Ying would be injured and ordered him to release the reins; Ying firmly held them for a long time before stopping.

sentences.zh: 帝問其故，曰：「馬奔蹶，不過傷臣；

translations.literal: The emperor asked the reason. He said: "If the horse runs wild and stumbles, it will injure only your servant;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked the reason. He said, "If the horse runs wild and stumbles, it will injure only your servant;

sentences.zh: 如舍之，或犯清塵，雖臣萬死，何以塞責？」

translations.literal: if I release the reins, it may offend the imperial dust. Though your servant die ten thousand deaths, how could I answer for it?"
translations.idiomatic: if I release the reins, it may offend the imperial dust. Though your servant die ten thousand deaths, how could I answer for it?"

sentences.zh: 上嘉獎無已。

translations.literal: The emperor praised him without end.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him without end.

sentences.zh: 在梁州，拜給事中。

translations.literal: At Liang Prefecture he was appointed Drafting Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: At Liang Prefecture he was appointed Drafting Attendant.

sentences.zh: 映白晰長大，言音高朗。

translations.literal: Ying was fair-skinned, tall, and his speech was high and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was fair-skinned, tall, and his speech was high and clear.

sentences.zh: 上自山南還京，常令映侍左右，或令前馬，至城邑州鎮，俾映宣詔令，帝益親信之。

translations.literal: When the emperor returned to the capital from south of the mountains, he often had Ying attend at his side, or ordered him to ride ahead. When they reached cities, towns, and prefectures, he had Ying proclaim edicts and orders; the emperor trusted him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor returned to the capital from south of the mountains, he often had Ying attend at his side, or ordered him to ride ahead. When they reached cities, towns, and prefectures, he had Ying proclaim edicts and orders; the emperor trusted him all the more.

sentences.zh: 其年冬，轉中書舍人。

translations.literal: That winter he was transferred to Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was transferred to Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年，以本官與左散騎常侍劉滋、給事中崔造同拜平章事。

translations.literal: In Zhenyuan 2, with his existing office together with Left Regular Attendant Liu Zi and Drafting Attendant Cui Zao he was jointly appointed Co-equal Commissioner of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 2, with his existing office together with Left Regular Attendant Liu Zi and Drafting Attendant Cui Zao he was jointly appointed Co-equal Commissioner of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 滋以端默雅重寡言，映謙和美言悅下，無所是非，政事多決於造。

translations.literal: Zi was upright, silent, elegant, weighty, and sparing of words; Ying was modest, harmonious, pleasant in speech, and pleasing to subordinates, deciding nothing on right or wrong; most affairs of government were decided by Zao.
translations.idiomatic: Zi was upright, silent, elegant, weighty, and sparing of words; Ying was modest, harmonious, pleasant in speech, and pleasing to subordinates, deciding nothing on right or wrong; most affairs of government were decided by Zao.

sentences.zh: 無幾，造疾病，映當國政，乘間亦敢言事。

translations.literal: Before long Zao fell ill; Ying handled state affairs and also seized opportunities to dare speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zao fell ill; Ying handled state affairs and also seized opportunities to dare speak on affairs.

sentences.zh: 時吐蕃數入寇，人情搖動，且言帝欲行幸避狄。

translations.literal: At the time the Tibetans repeatedly raided; public sentiment was shaken, and it was said the emperor wished to go on tour to avoid the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Tibetans repeatedly raided; public sentiment was shaken, and it was said the emperor wished to go on tour to avoid the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 映奏曰：「戎狄亂華，臣之罪也。

translations.literal: Ying memorialized, saying: "The barbarians disturb China—this is your servant's crime.
translations.idiomatic: Ying memorialized, saying, "The barbarians disturb China—this is your servant's crime.

sentences.zh: 今人情恟懼，謂陛下理裝具糗糧，臣聞大福不再，奈何不與臣等熟計之？」

translations.literal: Now public sentiment is fearful and alarmed, saying Your Majesty is packing baggage and preparing provisions. I have heard that great fortune does not come twice—why not deliberate thoroughly with us?"
translations.idiomatic: Now public sentiment is fearful and alarmed, saying Your Majesty is packing baggage and preparing provisions. I have heard that great fortune does not come twice—why not deliberate thoroughly with us?"

sentences.zh: 因俯伏流涕，上亦為之感動。

translations.literal: Thereupon he prostrated himself and wept; the emperor too was moved.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he prostrated himself and wept; the emperor too was moved.

sentences.zh: 時給事中袁高忤旨，映連請為左丞、御史大夫。

translations.literal: At the time Drafting Attendant Yuan Gao offended the imperial intent; Ying repeatedly requested him as Left Assistant and Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Drafting Attendant Yuan Gao offended the imperial intent; Ying repeatedly requested him as Left Assistant and Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 映於東都舉進士及宏詞時，張延賞為河南尹、東都留守，厚映。

translations.literal: When Ying took the jinshi and hongci examinations at the Eastern Capital, Zhang Yanshang was Prefect of Henan and Eastern Capital Regent and treated Ying generously.
translations.idiomatic: When Ying took the jinshi and hongci examinations at the Eastern Capital, Zhang Yanshang was Prefect of Henan and Eastern Capital Regent and treated Ying generously.

sentences.zh: 及映為相，延賞罷相為左僕射，數畫時事令映行之，及為所親求官，映多不應。

translations.literal: When Ying became chief minister, Yanshang left the chancellorship and became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs. He repeatedly outlined current affairs for Ying to carry out, and when those close to him sought office, Ying mostly did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: When Ying became chief minister, Yanshang left the chancellership and became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs. He repeatedly outlined current affairs for Ying to carry out, and when those close to him sought office, Ying mostly did not agree.

sentences.zh: 延賞怒，言映非宰相器。

translations.literal: Yanshang grew angry and said Ying was not material for a chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshang grew angry and said Ying was not material for a chief minister.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，貶映夔州刺史，又轉衡州。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Ying was demoted to Prefect of Kui Prefecture, then transferred to Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year Ying was demoted to Prefect of Kui Prefecture, then transferred to Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七年，授御史中丞、桂管觀察使，又改洪州刺史、江西觀察使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed Censor-in-Chief and Guiguan Observation Commissioner, then changed to Prefect of Hong Prefecture and Jiangxi Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed Censor-in-Chief and Guiguan Observation Commissioner, then changed to Prefect of Hong Prefecture and Jiangxi Observation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 映常以頃為相輔，無大過而罷，冀其復入用，乃掊斂貢奉，及大為金銀器以希旨。

translations.literal: Ying often thought that he had recently been a chief minister, dismissed without great fault, and hoped to be recalled to service; he therefore extorted tribute offerings and greatly made gold and silver vessels to please the emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Ying often thought that he had recently been a chief minister, dismissed without great fault, and hoped to be recalled to service; he therefore extorted tribute offerings and greatly made gold and silver vessels to please the emperor's intent.

sentences.zh: 先是，銀瓶高者五尺余，李兼為江西觀察使，乃進六尺者，至是，因帝誕日端午，映為瓶高八尺者以獻。

translations.literal: Earlier, silver vases had been as high as five feet or more. When Li Jian was Jiangxi Observation Commissioner he presented one six feet high. At this time, because the emperor's birthday fell on the Dragon Boat Festival, Ying made a vase eight feet high and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, silver vases had been as high as five feet or more. When Li Jian was Jiangxi Observation Commissioner he presented one six feet high. At this time, because the emperor's birthday fell on the Dragon Boat Festival, Ying made a vase eight feet high and presented it.

sentences.zh: 貞元十一年七月卒，時年四十八，贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Zhenyuan 11 he died, aged forty-eight, and was posthumously made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Zhenyuan 11 he died, aged forty-eight, and was posthumously made Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 劉滋，字公茂，左散騎常侍子玄之孫。

translations.literal: Liu Zi, styled Gongmao, was the grandson of Left Regular Attendant Zixuan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zi (styled Gongmao) was the grandson of Left Regular Attendant Zixuan.

sentences.zh: 父貺，開元初為左拾遺，父子仍代為史官。

translations.literal: His father Kuang in the early Kaiyuan era was Left Reminder; father and son in succession served as historiographers.
translations.idiomatic: His father Kuang in the early Kaiyuan era was Left Reminder; father and son in succession served as historiographers.

sentences.zh: 貺依劉向《說苑》撰《續說苑》一十卷以獻，玄宗嘉之。

translations.literal: Kuang, following Liu Xiang's Garden of Persuasions, compiled Continuation of the Garden of Persuasions in ten scrolls and presented it; Xuanzong commended it.
translations.idiomatic: Kuang, following Liu Xiang's Garden of Persuasions, compiled Continuation of the Garden of Persuasions in ten scrolls and presented it; Xuanzong commended it.

sentences.zh: 滋少以門廕，調授太子正字，歷漣水令。

translations.literal: Zi in youth, through hereditary privilege, was appointed by selection as Corrector of the Heir Apparent and served as magistrate of Lianshui.
translations.idiomatic: Zi in youth, through hereditary privilege, was appointed by selection as Corrector of the Heir Apparent and served as magistrate of Lianshui.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎楊綰薦滋堪為諫官，拜左補闕，改太常卿，復為左補闕。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yang Guan recommended Zi as fit to be a remonstrance official; he was appointed Left Supplementation Officer, changed to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and again made Left Supplementation Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yang Guan recommended Zi as fit to be a remonstrance official; he was appointed Left Supplementation Officer, changed to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and again made Left Supplementation Officer.

sentences.zh: 辭官侍親還東都，河南尹李廙署奏功曹參軍。

translations.literal: He resigned office to attend his parents and returned to the Eastern Capital; Prefect of Henan Li Yi registered and memorialized him as Merit Officer.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned office to attend his parents and returned to the Eastern Capital; Prefect of Henan Li Yi registered and memorialized him as Merit Officer.

sentences.zh: 無幾，丁母喪，服除，遷屯田員外郎，轉司勛員外郎，判南曹，勤於吏職，孜孜奉法。

translations.literal: Before long he entered mourning for his mother. When mourning ended he was promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Public Works, transferred to Vice Director in the Ministry of Merit, and judged the Southern Bureau, diligent in official duty and assiduous in following the law.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he entered mourning for his mother. When mourning ended he was promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Public Works, transferred to Vice Director in the Ministry of Merit, and judged the Southern Bureau, diligent in official duty and assiduous in following the law.

sentences.zh: 遷司勛郎中，累拜給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Merit and repeatedly appointed Drafting Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Merit and repeatedly appointed Drafting Attendant.

sentences.zh: 從幸奉天，轉太常少卿，掌禮儀。

translations.literal: Following the emperor to Fengtian he was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and managed ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Following the emperor to Fengtian he was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and managed ritual.

sentences.zh: 興元元年，改吏部侍郎，往洪州知選事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingyuan he was changed to Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and went to Hong Prefecture to manage selection affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xingyuan he was changed to Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and went to Hong Prefecture to manage selection affairs.

sentences.zh: 時京師寇盜之後，天下蝗旱，谷價翔貴，選人不能赴調，乃命滋江南典選，以便江、嶺之人，時稱舉職。

translations.literal: At the time, after bandits and robbers in the capital, the realm suffered locusts and drought, grain prices soared, and selectees could not come for reassignment. Zi was ordered to manage selection south of the Yangzi to accommodate men of the Jiang and Ling regions; the age praised his fulfillment of duty.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, after bandits and robbers in the capital, the realm suffered locusts and drought, grain prices soared, and selectees could not come for reassignment. Zi was ordered to manage selection south of the Yangzi to accommodate men of the Jiang and Ling regions; the age praised his fulfillment of duty.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年，遷左散騎常侍、同中書門下平章事，在相位無所啟奏，但多謙退，廉謹畏慎而已。

translations.literal: In Zhenyuan 2 he was promoted to Left Regular Attendant and Co-equal Commissioner of the Secretariat and Chancellery. In the chancellorship he offered no memorials, but was mostly modest and yielding, frugal, cautious, and fearful—that was all.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 2 he was promoted to Left Regular Attendant and Co-equal Commissioner of the Secretariat and Chancellery. In the chancellorship he offered no memorials, but was mostly modest and yielding, frugal, cautious, and fearful—that was all.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，守本官，罷知政事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year he kept his existing office and ceased managing affairs of government.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year he kept his existing office and ceased managing affairs of government.

sentences.zh: 四年，復為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he again became Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he again became Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted to Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 竇參以宰相為吏部尚書，換刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Dou Can, as chief minister, became Minister of Personnel; Zi was exchanged to Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Can, as chief minister, became Minister of Personnel; Zi was exchanged to Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 無何，御史臺劾奏滋前在吏部選人渝濫，詔奪金紫階。

translations.literal: Before long the Censorate impeached and memorialized that when Zi was previously in the Ministry of Personnel selectees were excessive and lax; an edict stripped his gold and purple rank.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Censorate impeached and memorialized that when Zi was previously in the Ministry of Personnel selectees were excessive and lax; an edict stripped his gold and purple rank.

sentences.zh: 滋有經學，善持論，性廉潔刻苦，嫉惡，掌選多所發擿更代，詐偽者尤畏之。

translations.literal: Zi had classical learning, was good at holding discourse, and by nature was frugal, austere, and hating evil. In managing selection he often exposed dismissals and replacements; those who were fraudulent especially feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Zi had classical learning, was good at holding discourse, and by nature was frugal, austere, and hating evil. In managing selection he often exposed dismissals and replacements; those who were fraudulent especially feared him.

sentences.zh: 十年十月卒，時年六十六，贈陜州大都督。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the tenth year he died, aged sixty-six, and was posthumously made Grand Governor of Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the tenth year he died, aged sixty-six, and was posthumously made Grand Governor of Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 滋從兄贊，大歷中左散騎常侍匯之子。

translations.literal: Zi's older male cousin by the same grandfather Zan was the son of Left Regular Attendant Hui in the Dali era.
translations.idiomatic: Zi's older male cousin by the same grandfather Zan was the son of Left Regular Attendant Hui in the Dali era.

sentences.zh: 少以資廕補吏，累授鄠縣丞，宰相杜鴻漸自南還朝，途出於鄠，贊儲供精辦。

translations.literal: In youth, through material privilege, he entered clerical service and was repeatedly appointed Assistant Magistrate of E County. When Chief Minister Du Hongjian returned from the south to court, his route passed through E; Zan prepared supplies meticulously.
translations.idiomatic: In youth, through material privilege, he entered clerical service and was repeatedly appointed Assistant Magistrate of E County. When Chief Minister Du Hongjian returned from the south to court, his route passed through E; Zan prepared supplies meticulously.

sentences.zh: 鴻漸判官楊炎以贊名儒之子，薦之，累授侍御史、浙江觀察判官。

translations.literal: Hongjian's judge Yang Yan, because Zan was the son of a famous scholar, recommended him; he was repeatedly appointed Attending Censor and Zhejiang Observation Judge.
translations.idiomatic: Hongjian's judge Yang Yan, because Zan was the son of a famous scholar, recommended him; he was repeatedly appointed Attending Censor and Zhejiang Observation Judge.

sentences.zh: 楊炎作相，擢為歙州刺史，以勤幹聞。

translations.literal: When Yang Yan became chief minister, Zan was promoted to Prefect of She Prefecture and was known for diligence and competence.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Yan became chief minister, Zan was promoted to Prefect of She Prefecture and was known for diligence and competence.

sentences.zh: 有老婦人捃拾榛間，猛獸將噬之，幼女號呼搏獸而救之，母子俱免。

translations.literal: An old woman was gathering hazelnuts when a fierce beast was about to devour her; a young girl cried out and fought the beast to save her, and mother and child both escaped.
translations.idiomatic: An old woman was gathering hazelnuts when a fierce beast was about to devour her; a young girl cried out and fought the beast to save her, and mother and child both escaped.

sentences.zh: 宣歙觀察使韓滉表其異行，加金紫之服，再遷常州刺史。

translations.literal: Xuan-She Observation Commissioner Han Huang memorialized this extraordinary conduct; he was given gold and purple dress and was promoted again to Prefect of Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan-She Observation Commissioner Han Huang memorialized this extraordinary conduct; he was given gold and purple dress and was promoted again to Prefect of Chang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 韓滉入相，分舊所統為三道，以贊為宣州刺史、兼御史中丞、宣歙池都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: When Han Huang entered the chancellorship he divided what he had formerly commanded into three circuits; Zan was made Prefect of Xuan Prefecture, concurrently Censor-in-Chief, and Xuan-She-Chi All-Circuits Training and Defense Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Huang entered the chancellorship he divided what he had formerly commanded into three circuits; Zan was made Prefect of Xuan Prefecture, concurrently Censor-in-Chief, and Xuan-She-Chi All-Circuits Training and Defense Observation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 贊在宣州十余年。

translations.literal: Zan was at Xuan Prefecture for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Zan was at Xuan Prefecture for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 贊祖子玄，開元朝一代名儒，父匯博涉經史，唯贊不知書，但以強猛立威，官吏畏之，重足一跡。

translations.literal: Zan's grandfather Zixuan was a famous scholar of a generation in the Kaiyuan court; his father Hui broadly mastered the classics and histories; only Zan did not know books, but relied on forceful severity to establish authority, and officials feared him, treading as though on thin ice.
translations.idiomatic: Zan's grandfather Zixuan was a famous scholar of a generation in the Kaiyuan court; his father Hui broadly mastered the classics and histories; only Zan did not know books, but relied on forceful severity to establish authority, and officials feared him, treading as though on thin ice.

sentences.zh: 宣為天下沃饒，贊久為廉察，厚斂殖貨，蝢貢奉以希恩。

translations.literal: Xuan was rich and fertile under heaven; Zan long served as fiscal inspector, heavily levied and amassed goods, and prepared tribute offerings to seek favor.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan was rich and fertile under heaven; Zan long served as fiscal inspector, heavily levied and amassed goods, and prepared tribute offerings to seek favor.

sentences.zh: 子弟皆虧庭訓，雖童年稚齒，便能侮易驕人，人士鄙之。

translations.literal: His sons and younger brothers all lacked family instruction; even in childhood they could insult and look down on others; gentlemen despised them.
translations.idiomatic: His sons and younger brothers all lacked family instruction; even in childhood they could insult and look down on others; gentlemen despised them.

sentences.zh: 貞元十二年卒，時年七十，贈吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In Zhenyuan 12 he died, aged seventy, and was posthumously made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 12 he died, aged seventy, and was posthumously made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 盧邁，字子玄，范陽人。

translations.literal: Lu Mai, styled Zixuan, was a man of Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Mai (styled Zixuan) was from Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 少以孝友謹厚稱，深為叔舅崔祐甫所親重。

translations.literal: In youth he was known for filial piety, friendship, prudence, and solidity, and was deeply favored and esteemed by his maternal uncle Cui Youfu.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was known for filial piety, friendship, prudence, and solidity, and was deeply favored and esteemed by his maternal uncle Cui Youfu.

sentences.zh: 兩經及第，歷太子正字、藍田尉。

translations.literal: He passed both classics examinations and served in succession as Corrector of the Heir Apparent and magistrate of Lantian.
translations.idiomatic: He passed both classics examinations and served in succession as Corrector of the Heir Apparent and magistrate of Lantian.

sentences.zh: 以書判拔萃，授河南主簿，充集賢校理。

translations.literal: Through outstanding performance in document judgment he was appointed Chief Clerk of Henan and served as collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Through outstanding performance in document judgment he was appointed Chief Clerk of Henan and served as collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 朝臣薦其文行，遷右補闕、侍御史、刑部吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: Court ministers recommended his literary conduct; he was promoted to Right Supplementation Officer, Attending Censor, and Vice Director in the Ministries of Justice and Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Court ministers recommended his literary conduct; he was promoted to Right Supplementation Officer, Attending Censor, and Vice Director in the Ministries of Justice and Personnel.

sentences.zh: 邁以叔父兄弟姊妹悉在江介，屬蝗蟲歲饑，懇求江南上佐，由是授滁州刺史。

translations.literal: Mai's uncles, brothers, and sisters were all in the Jiang region; in a year of locusts and famine he earnestly requested a senior post in the south, and thereby was appointed Prefect of Chu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mai's uncles, brothers, and sisters were all in the Jiang region; in a year of locusts and famine he earnestly requested a senior post in the south, and thereby was appointed Prefect of Chu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 入為司門郎中，遷右諫議大夫，累上表言時政得失。

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Director in the Ministry of Gateways, was promoted to Right Remonstrance and Censor, and repeatedly submitted memorials on the gains and losses of current policy.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as Director in the Ministry of Gateways, was promoted to Right Remonstrance and Censor, and repeatedly submitted memorials on the gains and losses of current policy.

sentences.zh: 轉給事中，屬校定考課，邁固讓，以授官日近，未有政績，不敢當上考，時人重之。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Drafting Attendant. When performance evaluations were being settled, Mai firmly declined, saying that since the date of appointment was recent and he had no administrative achievement, he did not dare accept the highest rating; men of the age respected this.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Drafting Attendant. When performance evaluations were being settled, Mai firmly declined, saying that since the date of appointment was recent and he had no administrative achievement, he did not dare accept the highest rating; men of the age respected this.

sentences.zh: 遷尚書右丞。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Assistant of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Assistant of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 將作監元亙當攝太尉享昭德皇后廟，以私忌日不受誓誡，為御史劾奏，詔尚書省與禮官、法官集議。

translations.literal: Director of Imperial Construction Yuan Gen was to act as Grand Marshal in sacrificing at the shrine of Empress Zhaode, but on a private mourning anniversary he would not receive the oath of abstinence. The censorate impeached and memorialized him; an edict ordered the Ministry of Personnel, ritual officials, and legal officials to deliberate jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Imperial Construction Yuan Gen was to act as Grand Marshal in sacrificing at the shrine of Empress Zhaode, but on a private mourning anniversary he would not receive the oath of abstinence. The censorate impeached and memorialized him; an edict ordered the Ministry of Personnel, ritual officials, and legal officials to deliberate jointly.

sentences.zh: 邁奏狀曰：「臣按《禮記》，大夫士將祭於公，既視濯而父母死，猶奉祭。

translations.literal: Mai submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant examines the 'Records of Ritual': when a grandee or officer is about to sacrifice for the ruler, and after the washing of the sacrificial vessels his parents die, he still completes the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Mai submitted a memorial, saying, "Your servant examines the 'Records of Ritual': when a grandee or officer is about to sacrifice for the ruler, and after the washing of the sacrificial vessels his parents die, he still completes the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 又按唐禮，散齋有大功之喪，致齋有周親喪，齋中疾病，即還家不奉祭事，皆無忌日不受誓誡之文。

translations.literal: Examining Tang ritual as well: during preliminary abstinence one may have mourning for a relative within the second degree of mourning; during strict abstinence one may have mourning for a relative within the first degree; if ill during abstinence one returns home and does not perform the sacrifice—nowhere is there text on refusing the oath of abstinence on a mourning anniversary.
translations.idiomatic: Examining Tang ritual as well: during preliminary abstinence one may have mourning for a relative within the second degree of mourning; during strict abstinence one may have mourning for a relative within the first degree; if ill during abstinence one returns home and does not perform the sacrifice—nowhere is there text on refusing the oath of abstinence on a mourning anniversary.

sentences.zh: 雖假寧令忌日給假一日，《春秋》之義，不以家事辭王事。

translations.literal: Although the leave regulations grant one day of leave on a mourning anniversary, the meaning of the 'Spring and Autumn Annals' is that one does not decline royal service because of family affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Although the leave regulations grant one day of leave on a mourning anniversary, the meaning of the 'Spring and Autumn Annals' is that one does not decline royal service because of family affairs.

sentences.zh: 今亙以假寧常式，而違攝祭新命，酌其輕重，誓誡則祀事之嚴，校其禮式，忌日乃尋常之制，詳求典據，事緣薦獻，不宜以忌日為辭。」

translations.literal: Now Gen relies on the ordinary form of leave but violates the new order to act in sacrifice. Weighing severity: the oath of abstinence belongs to the strictness of the sacrificial affair; comparing ritual forms, the mourning anniversary is an ordinary regulation. Searching the canonical grounds in detail, the affair concerns offering and presentation—it is not fitting to use the mourning anniversary as an excuse."
translations.idiomatic: Now Gen relies on the ordinary form of leave but violates the new order to act in sacrifice. Weighing severity: the oath of abstinence belongs to the strictness of the sacrificial affair; comparing ritual forms, the mourning anniversary is an ordinary regulation. Searching the canonical grounds in detail, the affair concerns offering and presentation—it is not fitting to use the mourning anniversary as an excuse."

sentences.zh: 由是亙坐罰俸。

translations.literal: Thereupon Gen was punished by forfeiture of salary.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Gen was punished by forfeiture of salary.

sentences.zh: 邁九年以本官同中書門下平章事；

translations.literal: In Mai's ninth year, with his existing office he became Co-equal Commissioner of the Secretariat and Chancellery;
translations.idiomatic: In Mai's ninth year, with his existing office he became Co-equal Commissioner of the Secretariat and Chancellery;

sentences.zh: 歲餘，遷中書侍郎。

translations.literal: after more than a year he was promoted to Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: after more than a year he was promoted to Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時大政決在陸贄、趙憬，邁謹身中立，守文奉法而已。

translations.literal: At the time great affairs were decided by Lu Zhi and Zhao Jing; Mai kept himself upright and neutral, preserving the documents and following the law—that was all.
translations.idiomatic: At the time great affairs were decided by Lu Zhi and Zhao Jing; Mai kept himself upright and neutral, preserving the documents and following the law—that was all.

sentences.zh: 而友愛恭儉。

translations.literal: Yet he was friendly, loving, respectful, and frugal.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was friendly, loving, respectful, and frugal.

sentences.zh: 邁從父弟MH，為劍南西川判官，卒於成都，歸葬於洛陽，路由京師，邁奏請至城東哭於其柩，許之。

translations.literal: Mai's younger male cousin by the same grandfather Qi served as judge of the Western Sichuan Circuit of the Southern Route; he died at Chengdu and was buried at Luoyang. The route passed through the capital; Mai memorialized asking to go to the east of the city and weep before the bier, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Mai's younger male cousin by the same grandfather Qi served as judge of the Western Sichuan Circuit of the Southern Route; he died at Chengdu and was buried at Luoyang. The route passed through the capital; Mai memorialized asking to go to the east of the city and weep before the bier, and this was granted.

sentences.zh: 近代宰臣多自以為崇重，三服之親，或不過從而吊臨；

translations.literal: In recent times chief ministers mostly considered themselves lofty and weighty; for kin within three degrees of mourning they might not even follow to condole;
translations.idiomatic: In recent times chief ministers mostly considered themselves lofty and weighty; for kin within three degrees of mourning they might not even follow to condole;

sentences.zh: 而邁獨振薄俗，請臨弟喪，士君子是之。

translations.literal: but Mai alone stirred the thin custom and asked to attend his younger brother's mourning; gentlemen approved this.
translations.idiomatic: but Mai alone stirred the thin custom and asked to attend his younger brother's mourning; gentlemen approved this.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月，邁於政事堂中風，肩輿而歸，上表請罷官，不許，詔宰臣就第問疾。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twelfth year Mai suffered a stroke in the Hall of Administration, was carried home in a litter, and submitted a memorial asking to leave office; this was not granted, and an edict ordered the chief ministers to visit his residence and inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twelfth year Mai suffered a stroke in the Hall of Administration, was carried home in a litter, and submitted a memorial asking to leave office; this was not granted, and an edict ordered the chief ministers to visit his residence and inquire after his illness.

sentences.zh: 自是凡五上表，堅乞骸骨，詔曰：「卿操履貞方，器識淹茂，自居臺輔，益見忠清。

translations.literal: From this time he submitted five memorials in all, firmly requesting retirement. An edict said: "Your conduct and footing are upright and square; your capacity and insight are broad and abundant. Since taking the post of chief minister, loyalty and purity have been all the more seen.
translations.idiomatic: From this time he submitted five memorials in all, firmly requesting retirement. An edict said, "Your conduct and footing are upright and square; your capacity and insight are broad and abundant. Since taking the post of chief minister, loyalty and purity have been all the more seen.

sentences.zh: 方藉謀猷，遽嬰疾疹，歲月滋久，章表屢聞，陳請再三，捴謙難奪。
