translations.literal: Just when we relied on your counsel, you suddenly fell ill. Months and years grow longer; memorials repeatedly arrive; petitions are made again and again; modest yielding is hard to override.
translations.idiomatic: Just when we relied on your counsel, you suddenly fell ill. Months and years grow longer; memorials repeatedly arrive; petitions are made again and again; modest yielding is hard to override.

sentences.zh: 且備養賢之禮，宜遂優閑之秩，告免之誠，雖為懇至，俯從來奏，良用憮然。」

translations.literal: Moreover the rites for nurturing the worthy should now grant a leisurely rank. Though the sincerity of requesting release is earnest, we bow to your submitted memorial and are truly disheartened."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the rites for nurturing the worthy should now grant a leisurely rank. Though the sincerity of requesting release is earnest, we bow to your submitted memorial and are truly disheartened."

sentences.zh: 乃除太子賓客。

translations.literal: He was then made Senior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made Senior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 貞元十四年卒，時年六十，贈太子太傅，賻以布帛。

translations.literal: In Zhenyuan 14 he died, aged sixty, and was posthumously made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; funeral gifts of cloth and silk were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 14 he died, aged sixty, and was posthumously made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; funeral gifts of cloth and silk were granted.

sentences.zh: 邁再娶無子，以從父弟子紀為嗣。

translations.literal: Mai married again and had no sons; he took his younger male cousin's son Ji as heir.
translations.idiomatic: Mai married again and had no sons; he took his younger male cousin's son Ji as heir.

sentences.zh: 崔損，字至無，博陵人。

translations.literal: Cui Sun, styled Zhiwu, was a man of Boling.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Sun (styled Zhiwu) was from Boling.

sentences.zh: 高祖行功已後，名位卑替。

translations.literal: After his great-grandfather Xinggong, name and rank were low and declined.
translations.idiomatic: After his great-grandfather Xinggong, name and rank were low and declined.

sentences.zh: 損大歷末進士擢第，登博學宏詞科，授秘書省校書郎，再授咸陽尉。

translations.literal: At the end of the Dali era Sun passed the jinshi examination, passed the Examination in Eminent Learning and Comprehensive Phrasing, was appointed collator in the Secretariat, and was again appointed magistrate of Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Dali era Sun passed the jinshi examination, passed the Examination in Eminent Learning and Comprehensive Phrasing, was appointed collator in the Secretariat, and was again appointed magistrate of Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 外舅王翃為京兆尹，改大理評事，累遷兵部郎中。

translations.literal: His father-in-law Wang Hong was Prefect of the Metropolitan Prefecture; he was changed to Evaluator in the Court of Judicial Review and was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: His father-in-law Wang Hong was Prefect of the Metropolitan Prefecture; he was changed to Evaluator in the Court of Judicial Review and was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 貞元十一年，遷右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In Zhenyuan 11 he was promoted to Right Remonstrance and Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 11 he was promoted to Right Remonstrance and Censor.

sentences.zh: 會門下侍郎平章事趙憬卒，中書侍朗平章事盧邁風病請告，戶部尚書裴延齡素與損善，乃薦之於德宗。

translations.literal: When Vice Director of the Chancellery and Co-equal Commissioner Zhao Jing died, and Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-equal Commissioner Lu Mai requested leave for illness, Minister of Revenue Pei Yanling had long been on good terms with Sun and therefore recommended him to Dezong.
translations.idiomatic: When Vice Director of the Chancellery and Co-equal Commissioner Zhao Jing died, and Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-equal Commissioner Lu Mai requested leave for illness, Minister of Revenue Pei Yanling had long been on good terms with Sun and therefore recommended him to Dezong.

sentences.zh: 十二年，以本官同中書門下平章事，與給事中趙宗儒同日知政事，並賜金紫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, with his existing office he became Co-equal Commissioner of the Secretariat and Chancellery, together with Drafting Attendant Zhao Zongru on the same day managing affairs of government; both were granted gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, with his existing office he became Co-equal Commissioner of the Secretariat and Chancellery, together with Drafting Attendant Zhao Zongru on the same day managing affairs of government; both were granted gold and purple.

sentences.zh: 初，二相有故，旬日中外颙望名德，損比無聲實，及制下之日，中外失望。

translations.literal: At first the two chief ministers had affairs of mourning; for ten days within and without the court looked expectantly for men of renown and virtue. Sun by comparison had no reputation or substance; when the appointment was issued, within and without the court were disappointed.
translations.idiomatic: At first the two chief ministers had affairs of mourning; for ten days within and without the court looked expectantly for men of renown and virtue. Sun by comparison had no reputation or substance; when the appointment was issued, within and without the court were disappointed.

sentences.zh: 性齷齪謹慎，每延英論事，未嘗有言。

translations.literal: By nature he was narrow, cautious, and timid; whenever affairs were discussed at Yanying Hall, he never spoke.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was narrow, cautious, and timid; whenever affairs were discussed at Yanying Hall, he never spoke.

sentences.zh: 十四年秋，轉門下侍郎平章事。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourteenth year he was transferred to Vice Director of the Chancellery and Co-equal Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourteenth year he was transferred to Vice Director of the Chancellery and Co-equal Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是歲，以昭陵舊宮為野火所焚，所司請修奉。

translations.literal: That year the old palace at Zhaoling was burned by wildfire; the relevant offices requested repair and maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: That year the old palace at Zhaoling was burned by wildfire; the relevant offices requested repair and maintenance.

sentences.zh: 「昭陵舊宮在山上，置來歲久，曾經野火燒爇，摧毀略盡，其宮尋移在瑤臺寺左側。

translations.literal: "The old palace at Zhaoling is on the mountain. Established long ago, it was once burned by wildfire and was largely destroyed; the palace was soon moved to the left side of Yaotai Temple.
translations.idiomatic: "The old palace at Zhaoling is on the mountain. Established long ago, it was once burned by wildfire and was largely destroyed; the palace was soon moved to the left side of Yaotai Temple.

sentences.zh: 今屬通年，欲議修置，緣供水稍遠，百姓勞弊，今欲於見住行宮處修創，冀久遠便人。

translations.literal: Now it is the year of universal mourning; repair and establishment are to be discussed. Because the supply of water is somewhat distant and the people are worn and exhausted, we now wish to build anew at the present traveling palace site, hoping that in the long term it will be convenient for people.
translations.idiomatic: Now it is the year of universal mourning; repair and establishment are to be discussed. Because the supply of water is somewhat distant and the people are worn and exhausted, we now wish to build anew at the present traveling palace site, hoping that in the long term it will be convenient for people.

sentences.zh: 又為移改舊制，恐禮意未周，宜令宰臣百僚集議。」

translations.literal: Moreover, because the old system is being moved and changed, I fear the ritual intent is not complete; the chief ministers and hundred officials should be ordered to deliberate jointly."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, because the old system is being moved and changed, I fear the ritual intent is not complete; the chief ministers and hundred officials should be ordered to deliberate jointly."

sentences.zh: 議者多云：「舊宮既焚，宜移就山下。」

translations.literal: Many of those deliberating said: "Since the old palace has burned, it should be moved down the mountain."
translations.idiomatic: Many of those deliberating said, "Since the old palace has burned, it should be moved down the mountain."

sentences.zh: 上意不欲遷移，只於山上重造，命損為八陵修奉使。

translations.literal: The emperor's intent did not wish to move it; he would rebuild only on the mountain and appointed Sun commissioner for repair and maintenance of the eight tombs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's intent did not wish to move it; he would rebuild only on the mountain and appointed Sun commissioner for repair and maintenance of the eight tombs.

sentences.zh: 於是獻、昭、乾、定、泰五陵造屋五百七十間，橋陵一百四十間，元陵三十間，唯建陵仍舊，但修葺而已。

translations.literal: Thereupon at the five tombs Xian, Zhao, Qian, Ding, and Tai five hundred seventy rooms were built; at Qiao Tomb one hundred forty rooms; at Yuan Tomb thirty rooms; only Jian Tomb remained as before, with repair only.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon at the five tombs Xian, Zhao, Qian, Ding, and Tai five hundred seventy rooms were built; at Qiao Tomb one hundred forty rooms; at Yuan Tomb thirty rooms; only Jian Tomb remained as before, with repair only.

sentences.zh: 所緣陵寢中床蓐帷幄一事以上，帝親自閱視，然後授損送於陵所。

translations.literal: For bedding, curtains, and all items in the tomb chambers and above, the emperor personally inspected them and then handed them to Sun to send to the tomb sites.
translations.idiomatic: For bedding, curtains, and all items in the tomb chambers and above, the emperor personally inspected them and then handed them to Sun to send to the tomb sites.

sentences.zh: 損以久疾在家，賜絹二百匹以為醫藥。

translations.literal: Sun, because of long illness at home, was granted two hundred bolts of silk for medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Sun, because of long illness at home, was granted two hundred bolts of silk for medicine.

sentences.zh: 南北兩省清要，損皆歷踐之，在位無稱於人者。

translations.literal: The honored posts of the northern and southern departments—Sun had passed through them all; in office he had no reputation among men.
translations.idiomatic: The honored posts of the northern and southern departments—Sun had passed through them all; in office he had no reputation among men.

sentences.zh: 身居宰相，母野殯，不言展墓，不議遷祔；

translations.literal: Though he held the chancellorship, his mother lay in an open coffin in the wild; he did not speak of visiting the tomb or discuss moving the coffin to join her husband;
translations.idiomatic: Though he held the chancellorship, his mother lay in an open coffin in the wild; he did not speak of visiting the tomb or discuss moving the coffin to join her husband;

sentences.zh: 姊為尼，沒於近寺，終喪不臨，士君子罪之。

translations.literal: his elder sister was a nun and died in a nearby temple; through the whole mourning he did not attend; gentlemen blamed him.
translations.idiomatic: his elder sister was a nun and died in a nearby temple; through the whole mourning he did not attend; gentlemen blamed him.

sentences.zh: 加以過為恭遜，接見便僻，不止於容身而已。

translations.literal: Added to this, he was excessively deferential and, in receiving visitors, was ingratiating—not merely seeking to preserve himself.
translations.idiomatic: Added to this, he was excessively deferential and, in receiving visitors, was ingratiating—not merely seeking to preserve himself.

sentences.zh: 自建中以後，宰相罕有久在位者，數歲罪黜；

translations.literal: From Jianzhong onward, chief ministers rarely remained long in office and within several years were dismissed for guilt;
translations.idiomatic: From Jianzhong onward, chief ministers rarely remained long in office and within several years were dismissed for guilt;

sentences.zh: 損用此中上意，竊大任者八年。

translations.literal: Sun used this to fit the emperor's intent and secretly held great responsibility for eight years.
translations.idiomatic: Sun used this to fit the emperor's intent and secretly held great responsibility for eight years.

sentences.zh: 上亦知物議鄙其持祿取容，然憐而厚之。

translations.literal: The emperor also knew that public opinion despised him for holding salary and seeking favor, yet pitied and treated him generously.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also knew that public opinion despised him for holding salary and seeking favor, yet pitied and treated him generously.

sentences.zh: 貞元十九年卒，贈太子太傅，賻布帛五百端、米粟四百石。

translations.literal: In Zhenyuan 19 he died and was posthumously made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; funeral gifts were five hundred bolts of cloth and silk and four hundred shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 19 he died and was posthumously made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; funeral gifts were five hundred bolts of cloth and silk and four hundred shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 齊抗，字遐舉，天寶中平陽太守浣之孫。

translations.literal: Qi Kang, styled Xiaju, was the grandson of Huan, Prefect of Pingyang in the Tianbao era.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Kang (styled Xiaju) was the grandson of Huan, Prefect of Pingyang in the Tianbao era.

sentences.zh: 父翺，一命卑官卒，以抗貴，累贈國子祭酒。

translations.literal: His father Ao died in a low first appointment; because of Kang's eminence he was repeatedly posthumously made Chancellor of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ao died in a low first appointment; because of Kang's eminence he was repeatedly posthumously made Chancellor of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 抗少隱會稽剡中讀書，為文長於箋奏。

translations.literal: Kang in youth retired to study in Shan of Kuaiji and was skilled in writing, excelling in memorials and reports.
translations.idiomatic: Kang in youth retired to study in Shan of Kuaiji and was skilled in writing, excelling in memorials and reports.

sentences.zh: 大歷中，壽州刺史張鎰辟為判官，明閑吏事，敏於文學，鎰甚重之。

translations.literal: In the Dali era Shou Prefect Zhang Yi summoned him as judge; he was clear and versed in clerical affairs and quick in literary learning; Yi greatly valued him.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dali era Shou Prefect Zhang Yi summoned him as judge; he was clear and versed in clerical affairs and quick in literary learning; Yi greatly valued him.

sentences.zh: 建中初，鎰為江西觀察使，抗亦隨在幕府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianzhong Yi was Jiangxi Observation Commissioner; Kang also followed him in the staff headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianzhong Yi was Jiangxi Observation Commissioner; Kang also followed him in the staff headquarters.

sentences.zh: 三年，鎰自中書侍郎平章事出鎮鳳翔，奏抗為監察御史，仍為賓佐，幕中籌畫，多出於抗。

translations.literal: In the third year Yi, from Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-equal Commissioner, went out to garrison Fengxiang and memorialized Kang as Supervising Censor, still serving as staff aide; planning in the headquarters mostly came from Kang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Yi, from Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-equal Commissioner, went out to garrison Fengxiang and memorialized Kang as Supervising Censor, still serving as staff aide; planning in the headquarters mostly came from Kang.

sentences.zh: 德宗在奉天，鎰為李楚琳所害。

translations.literal: Dezong was at Fengtian; Yi was killed by Li Chu Lin.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong was at Fengtian; Yi was killed by Li Chu Lin.

sentences.zh: 抗奔赴行在，拜侍御史，旬日改戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: Kang rushed to the mobile court and was appointed Attending Censor; within ten days he was changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Kang rushed to the mobile court and was appointed Attending Censor; within ten days he was changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 宰相蕭復為江淮宣慰使，以抗為判官。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Xiao Fu was Jiang-Huai Comforting Commissioner and made Kang his judge.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Xiao Fu was Jiang-Huai Comforting Commissioner and made Kang his judge.

sentences.zh: 德宗還京，大盜之後，天下旱蝗，國用盡竭。

translations.literal: When Dezong returned to the capital, after the great banditry, the realm suffered drought and locusts and state revenue was exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: When Dezong returned to the capital, after the great banditry, the realm suffered drought and locusts and state revenue was exhausted.

sentences.zh: 鹽鐵轉運使元琇以抗有才用，奏授倉部郎中，條理江淮鹽務。

translations.literal: Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner Yuan Xiu, because Kang had talent and use, memorialized appointing him Director in the Ministry of Granaries to put in order Jiang-Huai salt affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner Yuan Xiu, because Kang had talent and use, memorialized appointing him Director in the Ministry of Granaries to put in order Jiang-Huai salt affairs.

sentences.zh: 貞元初，為水陸運副使，督江淮漕運以給京師。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyuan he was Deputy Commissioner of Land and Water Transport, supervising Jiang-Huai grain transport to supply the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenyuan he was Deputy Commissioner of Land and Water Transport, supervising Jiang-Huai grain transport to supply the capital.

sentences.zh: 遷諫議大夫。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Remonstrance and Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Remonstrance and Censor.

sentences.zh: 歷處州刺史，轉潭州刺史、湖南都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: He served as Prefect of Chu Prefecture, then transferred to Prefect of Tan Prefecture and Hunan All-Circuits Training and Defense Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Prefect of Chu Prefecture, then transferred to Prefect of Tan Prefecture and Hunan All-Circuits Training and Defense Observation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 入為給事中，又為河南尹，歷秘書監、太常卿，代鄭余慶為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Drafting Attendant, then became Prefect of Henan, served as Director of the Secretariat and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and replaced Zheng Yuqing as Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-equal Commissioner of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as Drafting Attendant, then became Prefect of Henan, served as Director of the Secretariat and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and replaced Zheng Yuqing as Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-equal Commissioner of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 先是每年吏部選人試判，別奏官考覆，第其上下；

translations.literal: Earlier, each year selectees of the Ministry of Personnel were tested in document judgment; separate memorializing officials reviewed and ranked them high and low;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, each year selectees of the Ministry of Personnel were tested in document judgment; separate memorializing officials reviewed and ranked them high and low;

sentences.zh: 既考，中書門下復奏擇官覆定，浸以為便。

translations.literal: after the review the Secretariat and Chancellery again memorialized choosing officials to review and fix the ranking, and this gradually came to be regarded as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: after the review the Secretariat and Chancellery again memorialized choosing officials to review and fix the ranking, and this gradually came to be regarded as convenient.

sentences.zh: 抗乃奏曰：「吏部尚書、侍郎，已是朝廷精選，不宜別差考官重覆。」

translations.literal: Kang then memorialized, saying: "The Minister and Vice Directors of the Ministry of Personnel are already the court's careful selection; it is not fitting to appoint separate examining officials for repeated review."
translations.idiomatic: Kang then memorialized, saying, "The Minister and Vice Directors of the Ministry of Personnel are already the court's careful selection; it is not fitting to appoint separate examining officials for repeated review."

sentences.zh: 其年他官考判訖，俾吏部侍郎自覆，一歲遂除考判官，蓋抗所論奏也。

translations.literal: The next year, when other officials had finished examining document judgments, the Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel was made to review himself; within one year the document-judgment examining officials were abolished—this was Kang's memorialized proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, when other officials had finished examining document judgments, the Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel was made to review himself; within one year the document-judgment examining officials were abolished—this was Kang's memorialized proposal.

sentences.zh: 故事，禮部侍郎掌貢舉，其親故即試於考功。

translations.literal: By precedent the Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites managed the tribute examinations; his kin and friends were then tested at the Ministry of Merit.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites managed the tribute examinations; his kin and friends were then tested at the Ministry of Merit.

sentences.zh: 謂之「別頭舉人」，抗亦奏罷之。

translations.literal: They were called "separate-head examinees"; Kang also memorialized abolishing this.
translations.idiomatic: They were called "separate-head examinees"; Kang also memorialized abolishing this.

sentences.zh: 尋奏省諸州府別駕、田曹、司田官及判司之雙曹者，復省中書省驅使官及諸胥吏。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized abolishing vice-prefects, field-tax officials, and field-administration officials in all prefectures and districts, as well as duplicate bureau assistants; he also abolished dispatch clerks of the Secretariat and various clerks and attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he memorialized abolishing vice-prefects, field-tax officials, and field-administration officials in all prefectures and districts, as well as duplicate bureau assistants; he also abolished dispatch clerks of the Secretariat and various clerks and attendants.

sentences.zh: 尋加修國史。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally made compiler of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally made compiler of the national history.

sentences.zh: 抗雖讀書，無遠智大略，凡為官，必求至精，末乃滋彰，物論薄其隘刻。

translations.literal: Though Kang read books, he had no far-reaching wisdom or great design; in whatever office he held he always sought utmost precision, and in the end this became conspicuous; public opinion slighted him for narrow severity.
translations.idiomatic: Though Kang read books, he had no far-reaching wisdom or great design; in whatever office he held he always sought utmost precision, and in the end this became conspicuous; public opinion slighted him for narrow severity.

sentences.zh: 遇疾，上表請罷，改太子賓客，竟不任朝謝。

translations.literal: When he fell ill he submitted a memorial asking to leave office and was changed to Senior Mentor of the Heir Apparent; in the end he did not attend court thanks.
translations.idiomatic: When he fell ill he submitted a memorial asking to leave office and was changed to Senior Mentor of the Heir Apparent; in the end he did not attend court thanks.

sentences.zh: 貞元二十年卒，時年六十五，贈戶部尚書，又賜其家絹二百匹。

translations.literal: In Zhenyuan 20 he died, aged sixty-five, and was posthumously made Minister of Revenue; two hundred bolts of silk were also granted to his family.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 20 he died, aged sixty-five, and was posthumously made Minister of Revenue; two hundred bolts of silk were also granted to his family.

sentences.zh: 【贊】=史臣曰：竇參朋黨，不顧君上之誡，斯為悖矣。

translations.literal: [Commentary] The historiographer says: Dou Can formed factions and did not heed the ruler's admonition—this was rebellious.
translations.idiomatic: [Commentary] The historiographer says: Dou Can formed factions and did not heed the ruler's admonition—this was rebellious.

sentences.zh: 齊映曲貢希用甚謬，而愛君蒞事，往往有長者之言。

translations.literal: Qi Ying's crooked tribute and seeking reuse were very wrong, yet in loving the ruler and handling affairs he often had the words of an elder.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ying's crooked tribute and seeking reuse were very wrong, yet in loving the ruler and handling affairs he often had the words of an elder.

sentences.zh: 滋、邁家行修謹，臨事可稱，器雖齷齪，無廢為君子矣。

translations.literal: Zi and Mai had family conduct cultivated and careful, and in handling affairs could be praised; though their capacity was narrow, they were not disqualified from being gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: Zi and Mai had family conduct cultivated and careful, and in handling affairs could be praised; though their capacity was narrow, they were not disqualified from being gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 而損、抗之比，夫何足雲，遽汙臺槐，蓋時主之容易耳。

translations.literal: But men like Sun and Kang—what are they worth mentioning? Yet they suddenly stained the platform and locust tree—surely because the ruler of the age was too easy.
translations.idiomatic: But men like Sun and Kang—what are they worth mentioning? Yet they suddenly stained the platform and locust tree—surely because the ruler of the age was too easy.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：物之同器，貴於弘通。

translations.literal: The praise says: Things in the same vessel—what is valued is broad passage.
translations.idiomatic: The praise says: Things in the same vessel—what is valued is broad passage.

sentences.zh: 竇阿齊佞，偏诐斯同。

translations.literal: Dou fawned and Qi flattered; partial bias is the same.
translations.idiomatic: Dou fawned and Qi flattered; partial bias is the same.

sentences.zh: 滋、邁之行，可以飾躬。

translations.literal: The conduct of Zi and Mai can adorn the person.
translations.idiomatic: The conduct of Zi and Mai can adorn the person.

sentences.zh: 康濟蒸民，胡為厥中。

translations.literal: To bring ease to the steaming multitude—why place them in the middle?
translations.idiomatic: To bring ease to the steaming multitude—why place them in the middle?
